summary: Scorpio Gold filed a Form 6-K announcing a marketed public offering of up to 32,000,000 common shares at $0.25 per offered share for gross proceeds of up to $8M, upsized to $10M and closed at $10.8M. Velocity Trade acted as lead agent; the offering was done via a base shelf prospectus in Canada and exempt sales in the US. Net proceeds fund exploration at the Manhattan Property and working capital. The offering closed on July 23, 2026. This is an equity capital raise, not a special situation. Watch for dilution impact and subsequent exploration results.
